text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — found a couple of orphaned anchors and one 404 image on /docs/serving/runtime.md. I can make quick fixes but want owner ok. Links: https://redwood.dev/docs/serving/runtime.md#kv-cache-management and https://redwood.dev/docs/images/kv_cache_diagram.png (404).

Samir Gupta: I own serving/runtime, I can take the anchors. Is the image missing from the CDN or the repo?

Maya Patel: CDN returned 403 earlier today; looks like upload failed during last publish. Small anchor typos too: `kv-cache-management` vs `kv-cache-and-ttl`.

Leo Chen: @Samir ping — if you want me to re-upload the image I can. It's in the model-onboarding assets repo: `s3://redwood-docs-assets/kv_cache_diagram.png`.

Samir Gupta: If you can reupload that'd be great. Also can we add redirects for the old anchor names? Maybe easiest is a frontmatter redirect. Example to add to the top of the page:```redirect_from:
 - /docs/serving/runtime.md#kv-cache-management
 - /docs/serving/runtime.md#kv-cache-and-ttl```

Olivia Park: Quick process Q — do we create the PR against `main` or open a `docs/publish-fix` branch? I can handle the review.

Maya Patel: Small typo fixes -> `main` fine. Image reupload + redirect -> branch please. Tag @docs for review.

DocsBot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-6781--redwood-docs.netlify.app/docs/serving/runtime.html — check image and anchors :white_check_mark:.

Samir Gupta: Created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462 — includes anchor redirects and the typo fixes.

Maya Patel: Nice, leaving a quick manual check in the PR. Will merge after Olivia reviews.

Olivia Park: Reviewing now. If all good, will merge in ~30m :thumbsup:.

Leo Chen: Reuploaded image and invalidated CDN cache: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id D123 --paths /docs/images/kv_cache_diagram.png`.

Samir Gupta: Confirmed — image loads in deploy preview and anchors jump correctly. Thanks everyone :tada:.

Maya Patel: Closing loop: I'll add Samir and Leo to the docs OWNERS file for the serving/runtime section so future pings route to the right folks.

Olivia Park: Thanks Maya, appreciate it.

Samir Gupta: Good to close once PR is merged.

Maya Patel: Merged at 1765124056, closing thread.
